headline: Gameplay and tools programmer
summary: Gameplay programmer who builds tools for designers and keeps live mobile games stable.

experience.title: Gameplay Programmer
highlights: Rebuilt the save system for a mobile puzzle game after it lost progress on about 300 phones
Wrote a Unity frame-time overlay that cut hitches on low-end Android phones by 35 percent
Built a nightly smoke test that plays 40 levels on real devices and posts failures to Slack

projects.name: Tidepool
projects.description: A 2D roguelike in Godot with a reward table editor written in Python. Drops are tuned from a spreadsheet and the loot odds show in an in-game debug panel.
highlights: Designed the drop curve so a run feels rewarding by minute ten
